node.title: Identity-prefix plus flexible-budget MCA unsafe floor
node.statement: Let B be a finite subfield of F, D subset B have size n, C=RS[F,D,k], q=|F|>n, and k+1<=m<=n. Put w=m-k-1 and B*=floor(q/2^t). If binom(n,m)>|B|^w B* and binom(B*+1,2)k<q-n, then one simple-pole received line has at least B*+1 distinct support-wise MCA-bad ambient-field slopes at agreement m. Hence B_C(m)>B* and epsilon_mca(C,1-m/n)>2^-t. The q-|B| non-base-rational variant also holds with its printed restriction.
